rendered: The authors used the FTIR band at 871 cm^−1[1], which is the bending vibration of CH2 and is listed as a representative peak for PVDF. It was present in the cathode rejects and in the powder separated at room temperature, showing PVDF was still there. It was absent for the reclaimed powder filtered at high temperature[2] (hot filtration, 100 °C[3]), which showed that the PVDF binder had been removed.
